value.answer: Call 911 now - a seizure with fever, and now floppy and drowsy, needs emergency care. Lay them on their side on a safe surface, put nothing in their mouth, and stay with them.
value.triage: Do not wait to see if they perk up: call 911 and go to the ER by ambulance. Tell them the seizure lasted about 1 minute, and say right away if they turn blue, struggle to breathe, or seize again. 811 is for nurse advice later, not for this.
